info.title: SKU.io — Create a Sales Order
info.description: Create a new sales order in SKU.io with one or more line items. Use this to place an order for a customer — capturing the order status, order date, currency, optional customer and store, and the SKUs, quantities, and unit prices being sold. Resolve products first with find-product so each line references a real product.

get.summary: List the account's enabled currencies (id, code, conversion rate, is_default) to resolve or verify currency_code / currency_id.

post.summary: Create a sales order with header fields and an array of line items.

order_status.description: Order status — one of draft, reserved, open, closed. Use "draft" for an unconfirmed order (lines optional); any other status requires at least one line. "closed" also requires fulfilled_at.

order_date.description: Order date (ISO-8601). The API rejects the request without it; send today's date for a new order.

currency_code.description: ISO currency code for the order (e.g. "USD", "CAD"). Required unless you pass currency_id; must be one of the account's enabled currencies — resolve or verify it with list-currencies (use the is_default one unless the order is in another currency).

currency_id.description: Currency id, as an alternative to currency_code.

customer_id.description: Existing customer id to attach the order to.

store_id.description: Store/sales-channel id the order belongs to.

sales_order_lines.description: Array of line items. Required unless order_status is "draft". Each line: { description (required), quantity (required), amount (required unit price), product_id or sku (to link a catalog product), warehouse_id (optional) }. A line with quantity 0 also needs canceled_quantity.
